name: TRITICUM REPENS
urinary_symptoms: Frequent, difficult, and painful urination (Pop). Gravelly deposits. Catarrhal and purulent discharges (Pareira). Strangury, pyelitis; enlarged prostate. Chronic cystic irritability. Incontinence; constant desire. Urine is dense and causes irritation of the mucous surfaces.

source.title: TRITICUM REPENS-AGROPYRON REPENS - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
